Package frc.robot.constants

Class RobotConstants.DriveBase

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.constants.RobotConstants.DriveBase
Enclosing class:
RobotConstants
public static final class RobotConstants.DriveBase extends Object
Swerve drive base geometric dimensions.

Defines wheelbase, track width, bumper extents, and radii for kinematics calculations and obstacle clearance checks.

    • kBumperRadius

      public static final double kBumperRadius
      Bumper corner radius (diagonal half-distance).

      Used for circular collision detection. Calculated as: 0.5 * sqrt(length² + width²)

    • kDriveRadius

      public static final double kDriveRadius
      Drive base radius (module diagonal half-distance).

      Used for angular velocity calculations. Calculated as: 0.5 * sqrt(wheelbase² + trackWidth²)
